text:
Thank you - the big upward smear in pose 4 is exactly the feeling we want. Please redraw the same 6-pose sheet with these corrections:




1. ONE HAND ONLY: Sora holds the Kingdom Key in his RIGHT hand in every pose, with his fist in the middle of the handle. His left arm is free (out to the side or behind him for balance) - it never touches the Keyblade.

2. GROUNDED: in every pose both of his feet stay on the floor line. In the hit pose he can rise up onto his toes and stretch tall, but he must not jump or lift a knee.

3. The swing must FLOW from low in front to high: in pose 2 the Keyblade is held down LOW in front of him (tip near the floor, ahead of his front foot); in pose 3 it is coming up in front of his body at waist height; in pose 4 (the hit) it sweeps up through the space in front of him toward the opponent at screen right, his arm reaching up and forward, with the big upward smear arc; in pose 5 it finishes high above his head.

4. Pose 1 and pose 6 are the kneeling crouch from the first attachment (back knee down, Keyblade low behind him).




Keep everything else: plain white background, facing screen right, same 2D cel style, KH2 outfit and Kingdom Key, no text, two rows of three.
